Marissa — quick notes from commercial: the 30% uplift is fine as long as the committed rate is tiered and we keep a quarterly true-up (no retroactive billing beyond one quarter). We should avoid locking in a 24-month price guarantee. If they want 24 months on term, propose a 12+option structure: 12 months firm + 12 month auto-renew unless terminated with 60 days notice. That gives us flexibility to reprice if unit economics change.

Also confirm whether Helios expects a ramp schedule in the order form; the spreadsheet suggests an immediate start at increased units. If they want phased capacity, we can add month-by-month ramp cells.

Thanks for the heads up. I reviewed the redline and flagged three items that need attention:

1) Audit scope (§12) — Helios' language would allow overly broad document/infrastructure access. Counter: limit to records necessary to verify usage and security logs; require 30 days notice and one audit per 12 months unless agreed otherwise.
2) Indemnity tailoring (§8) — do not accept obligation that extends to Helios' downstream customers. Propose mutual limitation and carveouts tied to willful misconduct.
3) Term & termination (§3) — if we provide a 24-month term, include a price reopener at 12 months tied to cost indices (GPU pricing or hosting). Prefer 12+option approach per Karthik.

I prepared suggested alternative text and embedded them as comments in the attached PDF. I also added a clean markup for Addendum B to keep coverage windows explicit (UTC times, incident reporting SLA references).

If we need to push back on the retention clause, let's offer a narrow alternative: retain customer logs for 12 months with aggregated metrics retained longer.

Happy to join a call with Jordan and Helios' contracts team tomorrow if helpful.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Jordan — thanks for the submission and for the clear asks. We've reviewed internally and attached our consolidated response (Redwood_consolidated_redline.docx). High-level:

- Term: we can do a 24-month total term if we adopt a 12+option structure (12 firm + 12 automatic renewal unless either party gives 60 days notice).
- Capacity: we accept a 30% uplift committed, with quarterly true-up and a one-quarter retroactive correction cap. We added a phased ramp section in the order form — see tab "ramp" in the spreadsheet.
- Audit & retention: we proposed a narrowed audit clause (one audit per 12 months with 30 days notice, scope limited to usage verification and security logs) and 12 month retention for detailed logs + 36 months aggregated metrics.
- Pricing reopener: inserted a mid-term pricing reopener at month 12 tied to hosting cost index.

Requesting your confirmation on these points so we can move to DocuSign. If acceptable, I'll route to legal for signature-ready MSA and generate the DocuSign envelope. If Helios needs a redline-to-redline call, we can do 30 minutes tomorrow at 10am PT.

Thanks,

2) For the pricing reopener, can we limit the index to cloud hosting costs (not model licensing) and cap changes to +/-10% without an additional approval step?

If you can accept those two clarifications, we are ready for signature. Otherwise, happy to take the questions on a quick call next week.
